 Liverpool keen on Stuttgart defender Jeltsch - Wednesday's gossip 
 Image source, Daily Express Image caption, Daily Express back page
 Published 27 October 2026 
 Image source, Daily Telegraph Image caption, Daily Telegraph sports section
 Image source, Daily Star Image caption, Daily Star back page
 Stuttgart's promising defender Finn Jeltsch is attracting attention from Liverpool , Chelsea remain keen on Bournemouth midfielder Alex Scott while Arsenal , Tottenham and Newcastle are among the clubs keeping tabs on Germany striker Nicolo Tresoldi. 
 Liverpool , Barcelona and Real Madrid are among the top European clubs keen on Stuttgart's 20-year-old German centre-back Finn Jeltsch. (Sport - in Spanish) , external 
 Chelsea are fully focused on signing Alex Scott from Bournemouth after his move fell through in the summer, with the 23-year-old England midfielder also on Liverpool 's shortlist. (Florian Plettenberg) , external 
 Chelsea , Manchester City , Arsenal , Tottenham and Newcastle have all scouted Club Brugge's Germany youth international Nicolo Tresoldi. (Teamtalk) , external 
 However, Club Brugge have ruled out selling the 22-year-old striker in January. (Het Nieuwsblad, via Metro) , external 
 Manchester United had planned on sacking Michael Carrick this week but failed to settle on a replacement. (The I - subscription required) , external 
 Manchester United would have to pay Newcastle about £3m in compensation if they choose to appoint Eddie Howe as Carrick's successor. (Guardian) , external 
 Brighton have no concerns about losing 23-year-old Paraguay midfielder Diego Gomez, despite interest from AC Milan and Atletico Madrid . (Football Insider) , external 
 Pierre Sage remains under huge pressure and could be sacked if Crystal Palace lose against Tottenham on Saturday. (Guardian) , external 
 Liverpool will pursue Valencia winger David Otorbi in January if the La Liga side take up an option to increase the 19-year-old Spanish winger's release clause from £30m to £50m. (Football Insider) , external 
 Juventus have made Monaco's 25-year-old American striker Folarin Balogun, whose move to Everton on deadline day collapsed, their top January target. (Tuttosport - in Italian) , external
